Situation: This is the main part of the interview with the hiring manager. Your fit for the manager role is being assessed through your experience, results, and leadership style. Your concern about salary belongs here because this is where expectations, evaluation, and compensation are usually discussed and understood.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Hiring Manager.
Not in this scene: self-introduction, interview format, scheduling later rounds, accepting an offer, onboarding details.

explain how you manage people or projects — slot: the method
answer whether you have experience with something — slot: the area of experience
ask what success in this role looks like — slot: the time period
ask how performance is evaluated — slot: the area
ask what salary range is planned — slot: the role
ask whether the package includes a benefit — slot: the benefit
must_understand: asks about your current responsibilities and achievements
asks how you manage a team, projects, or priorities
asks whether you have experience in a specific area
says what results the company expects in the role
explains the salary range or what the package includes
